summary: This workflow prompts the user to enter their age using an input dialog. It then checks if the entered age is greater than or equal to 18. If the user is 18 or older, it displays a message indicating they are an adult. Otherwise, it displays a message indicating they are a minor. The workflow uses a string variable to capture the input and performs a numeric comparison after converting the input to an integer.

pad_action_mapping.description: Checks if the entered age (converted to integer) is greater than or equal to 18.
